body.x: Location-based apps that identify a building from coordinates alone are exposed to GPS error, while methods built on spatial maps or 3D scanning add computing and infrastructure requirements.
Rainbow Company starts from a simpler question: which building's outline lies in the user's line of sight?

Rainbow Company Corp., a Pangyo-based augmented reality (AR) company founded in November 2022, is led by CEO Jiho Park and has nine employees. At KES 2026, it is presenting ScanPang, an AR building-information layer for real-world spaces, and running a continuous live demonstration in which pointing a camera at an actual building triggers a real-time overlay.

When a user points a smartphone camera at a building, ScanPang overlays its name, distance and detailed information, with no search or waiting. It identifies buildings by calculating the intersection between a building's outline polygon and the user's line of sight. Because the match is geometric rather than based on coordinates alone, the company says it holds up against GPS error, and its low-computation design runs on the device with minimal server infrastructure. The same engine is built to run on smartphones, in-vehicle navigation through Android Auto and CarPlay and, in the future, AI glasses. The technology is covered by three registered patents and one pending application.

The company's existing business is NUPY, an AR photo service that includes IP-collaboration and custom AR photocards, AR photo kiosks and hologram boxes. NUPY has worked with about 50 companies and institutions, including CJ ENM, YG Entertainment and Sony Pictures Korea. Revenue is projected to rise from KRW 470 million (about USD 340,000) in 2025 to an estimated KRW 1.5 billion in 2026. Rainbow Company was selected for the TIPS program of the Korea SMEs and Startups Agency in December 2025.

In Japan, it has installed AR photo kiosks at NTT DOCOMO's Tokyo Marunouchi store and at a CJ ENM pop-up store in Shibuya, and completed an official AR merchandise kiosk at Kobe Stocks in August 2026. It has also made event-based deployments at KCON LA in the United States and a BTS photo exhibition in Thailand. Japan revenue was about KRW 300 million in 2025 and is projected at about KRW 2 billion in 2026.

Rainbow Company aims to reach 40 contracted companies for ScanPang by 2028, with first contracts expected from delivery agencies and mobility platforms in the first half of 2027. In Japan, it plans to set up a local joint venture in early 2027 and is seeking distribution partners with access to professional sports teams and venues, as well as joint-venture partners. The company says long review cycles at large platform companies and hiring Vision AI engineers are its main difficulties.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
